company.description: Coral develops new clinical tests to help providers streamline prior authorization and select the effective medication for a particular patient focusing on autoimmune conditions such as Inflammatory Bowel Disease and Rheumatoid Arthritis. It has also identified a unique population of non-responder patients and is working with drug developers to address this unmet medical need.

aiResearchSummary.text: Coral Genomics is focused on developing methods for analyzing cells to enhance clinical test procedures. Their approach aims to streamline the prior authorization process and optimize medication selection. This innovation could potentially refine the precision of clinical diagnostics and treatment efficacy.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Grant round raised $1,700,000, or 29.82% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $3,700,000, representing 64.91% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,673,977 to $10,201,510, a 1.18x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
